Messages.Author: Benjamin Harris
Messages.Body:
Just a real basic question. (I seem to have misplaced my copy of the rules. )

What does paralyzing a vamp entail? How do you unparalyze a vamp? Cards like
the stake are killers if it doesn't have a way of wearing of or
something.

Thanks.
Morgoth Eol (Morge for short. A little Vamp humor there. )

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
mo...@expert.cc.purdue.edu (Benjamin Harris) writes:





---
15.3
Paralyze: This sends a vampire to torpor, tapped. The vampire cannot be
untapped during the untap phase. Any vampire that encounters a vampire in
torpor may rescue it at no cost. A paralyzed vampire may be diablerized as
usual. Mark the vampire to show it has been paralyzed.
---

So, he can't rescue himself, but may be rescued at no cost by another vampire.
When rescued, he returns to the ready area, still tapped.
